statement.zh: Tello 1960 将查文表述为安第斯文明「母体/matriz」——史学假说，不作前陶北奇科定论。
statement.en: Tello 1960 frames Chavín as Andean civilizational “matriz” — historiographic hypothesis, not a Preceramic Norte Chico conclusion.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.
